target_invariant: For one user and one canonical functional slot, effective equipped identity count <= 1.

current_state.canonical_route_replacement: app.py:equip_item clears server-resolved same-slot rows and sets the requested row under a PostgreSQL user-row lock.
current_state.read_model_guard: B028-R1 fails closed for conflicted slots but does not prevent malformed storage.
current_state.malformed_data_precondition: Read-only detection and explicit repair/owner review are required before strict constraint creation.

options.name: NORMALIZED_SLOT_COLUMN_PLUS_PARTIAL_UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT

schema_shape.projection_authority: Derived from server EQUIPMENT_DEFS; not a new item-definition authority.
schema_shape.validity_constraint: equipped=false OR canonical_slot IS NOT NULL
schema_shape.unique_index: UNIQUE(user_id, canonical_slot) WHERE equipped=true AND canonical_slot IS NOT NULL
null_slot_allowed_when: unknown historical row awaiting explicit repair

options.rollback: Drop the partial unique index and projection column only after application code no longer depends on the projection; original equip_id/equipped fields remain the state authority.
options.direct_writer_coverage: Update monster settlement acquisition, admin grant, and equip replacement writers to populate/preserve canonical_slot.
options.admin_writer_behavior: Admin grant inserts equipped=0 with a server-derived projection; admin remove remains ownership deletion; admin does not directly equip.
options.malformed_historical_data: Detect duplicates, unknown IDs, EQUIPPED_WITH_NULL_CANONICAL_SLOT, go_stone_black, and xp_amulet HOLD state. Stop before either constraint is created until conflicts are repaired or explicitly quarantined.
options.performance: Indexed per-user slot enforcement and lookup; one bounded backfill.
options.sqlite_compatibility: Requires explicit dialect/version handling in future implementation and tests.
options.risk: Projection drift if a writer or catalog changes without synchronized update; before final constraints this requires detector and repair gating. Once the equipped-row validity constraint and partial unique index are active, projection drift cannot silently create an equipped NULL-slot row or a second effective equipped item in one user slot.

options.name: DERIVED_OR_GENERATED_SLOT_REPRESENTATION

schema_shape.projection: Generated expression or functional index mapping equip_id to slot.
schema_shape.constraint: Unique user plus derived slot for equipped rows.

options.backfill_requirement: Generated expression may avoid projection backfill, but unknown and malformed existing rows still require validation.
options.rollback: Drop generated object and index before restoring old application compatibility.
options.direct_writer_coverage: Database expression sees equip_id but cannot query the Python EQUIPMENT_DEFS registry.
options.admin_writer_behavior: Works only while a duplicated database mapping remains complete.
options.malformed_historical_data: Unknown IDs must map to null or fail; known-slot duplicates still block index creation.
options.performance: Good after index creation, with expression evaluation cost.
options.postgresql_compatibility: PostgreSQL generated expressions exist, but the application registry cannot be consulted; SQLite portability is weaker.
options.risk: Creates a second slot-definition representation and can drift from EQUIPMENT_DEFS.

options.name: SINGLE_COMMAND_WRITER_PLUS_RECONCILIATION_GUARD
options.rollback: Revert the command-service release; no schema rollback.
options.direct_writer_coverage: Safe only if every application/admin/import writer is removed or forced through the command boundary.
options.admin_writer_behavior: Must use the command service or remain an unequipped ownership mutation.
options.malformed_historical_data: Detection and fail-closed reads remain; storage can stay malformed until explicit repair.
options.performance: No migration cost; per-command locks and reconciliation queries.
options.postgresql_compatibility: Good, but correctness relies on application discipline.
options.risk: Cannot provide a hard invariant against an uncovered direct writer or out-of-band write.

migration_order: backfill known functional Equipment from EQUIPMENT_DEFS
repair or quarantine duplicate same-slot, unknown equip_id, equipped NULL-slot, go_stone_black, and xp_amulet rows
prove no equipped row has canonical_slot NULL
add partial unique user plus canonical-slot constraint
centralize command service and continue rollout
